performanceScope: Three serial isolated 1920×1080 D3D12 Shipping runs on Ryzen 7 5700/RTX 5060, each with eight seconds of warmup and 90 measured seconds at the default 60 FPS limit. Normal had no frames over 50 ms. Artificial repeated mass-spawn/restart stress retains ten and thirteen hitches, worst 85.9292 ms and 140.8145 ms. These are measured limits, not a guarantee of smooth performance during every stress burst.
